GroupingChoices: Merge all�By repeated resource�By scene layer�Individual instances�
GroupAllLevel: One Actor for the selected territory, with instanced components grouped by resource and appearance.
GroupAll: One group for the entire map. Useful for whole-map exports; large territories produce larger meshes.
GroupResources: Group instances with identical model paths, replacement materials and dyes; preserve every placement. Terrain tiles are grouped by resource.
GroupLayers: Group by layout file and scene layer. Nested objects belong to their top-level scene layer; terrain forms a separate group.
GroupInstances: Export each model instance separately; expand SGBs into child models and export terrain tile by tile.
LevelExportHint: Write a .umap offline: one Actor per group with ISM components. Preserves local mesh origins and relative instance transforms. No UE installation or running editor required.
BakedExportHint: UE: bake each group into a single mesh, retaining world positions without instanced components.
GltfExportHint: glTF/GLB: one scene file per group, retaining nodes and world positions. Changing grouping does not remove repeated placements.
NoLoadedTerritory: No loaded territory is available for export.
TerritoryChanged: The territory changed. Export the current territory again.
TerritoryHint: Export the entire territory without the nearby-object distance limit. In the current territory, loaded player furnishings are included with their actual placements and dyes; player layouts cannot be recovered in other territories. Manually selected festivals only match objects shared with the target branch. Dynamic objects use captured states; unloaded objects use file defaults.
TerritoryChangedFestival: The current territory changed. Select the territory again or choose a static festival branch.
LiveTerritory: Current territory: static files + runtime comparison
InstanceGeometryFailed: Could not generate geometry for instance {0}.
TerritoryComplete: Export complete: {0} groups; {1} static models, {2} runtime models, {3} housing/furnishing models, {4} missing resources, {5} unmatched child objects. See territory-report.json and territory-groups.json.
LayoutExportHint: Export each instance separately. Merged instances use the instance name; otherwise use part or model names. Scene positions are preserved. Unskinned objects become Static Meshes, skinned objects become Skeletal Meshes; mixed groups are merged separately. Lights, cameras and projected decals are excluded.
NoExportableModels: The selected instances have no exportable models.
MergeAllHint: Merge the instance and attachments into one model, preserving material slots and bones.
MergePartsHint: Merge each part within an instance; group attachments separately.
WindingHint:
Automatically flips triangle winding order when face normals don't match vertex normals.
Enable this if exported models have inverted or incorrect face normals.
TerrainRangeHint:
If enabled, the export will only include terrain within the specified distance from the player.
This is useful for reducing the size of the export, but may result in missing terrain in some areas.
VisibilityHint:
If enabled, the export will apply visibility flags based on EQP manipulations and certain in-game toggles (such as additional character features)
This will make sure the export only includes the models/submeshes that are currently visible on the character.
HiddenPartsHint:
If enabled, the export will skip any models that are not visible in the game.
Example: if an arena changes shape throughout an encounter, the export will only include the arena that is currently visible.
DeformerHint:
If enabled, the export will use the deformer to export the model.
This is recommended for most models, but will result in different deformations based on the race associated with the model.
ExportTypeHint:
Select the type of export to use, GLTF is recommended for most cases.
GLB is a binary version of GLTF, and OBJ is a legacy format that is not recommended for most cases.
PoseHint:
Reference Pose (None): no pose track.
Reference Pose with Scale (LocalScaleOnly): scale only.
[default] Pose (Local): scale, rotation and translation.
GposeCopies: In gpose, copies of targetable actors are created. Try selecting the character from the list again.
LayoutIncludeSharedGroupsWhereSubItemsAr: Include Shared Groups Where Sub Items Are Visible
OriginWarning: WARNING: Using Player or Origin as the origin point may cause issues with cutscenes
LayoutSharedHint:
If enabled, shared groups will be included in the layout if any of their sub items are visible.
This may mean that complex shared groups will be included in the layout, even if only a small subset of the items are within the cutoff distance.
If disabled, shared groups will only be included if the shared group origin is within the cutoff distance.
LayoutOriginHint:
The origin point for layout display (does not affect exports)
Player: The player's position
Camera: The camera's position
Origin: 0,0,0
